title: Essentials of Linguistics, 2nd Edition - 2nd Edition
description: This Second Edition of Essentials of Linguistics is considerably revised and expanded, including several new chapters, diverse language examples from signed and spoken languages, enhanced accessibility features, and an orientation towards equity and justice. While the primary audience is Canadian students of Introduction to Linguistics, it is also suitable for learners elsewhere, in online, hybrid, or in-person courses.
authors: Catherine Anderson - Author / Bronwyn Bjorkman - Author / Derek Denis - Author
